title: Metabolism Claims and the ESSENTIALS Line
lessons: The player first notices CELSIUS because the can and brand site make explicit metabolism and exercise-performance claims.
The player already drinks standard CELSIUS and considers the higher-caffeine ESSENTIALS line for harder training days.

text: Late gym. The can in the cooler says it can help your metabolism and exercise performance, and the website has studies to go with it.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Why does an energy drink have studies attached to it?

entry-first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Because I refuse to just be a loud can. I need everyone to know I'm a loud can with homework done.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: That sounded defensive already.

entry-first-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: It was! I say metabolism, I say exercise performance, and I point at published studies so you can go read them instead of taking my word. I move fast. I don't hide the receipts.

choice-first.speaker: CELSIUS
text: You're between sets. You've got ninety seconds. Go.

choices.text: I like that there's at least research behind the pitch.
I want to know what the studies actually measured.
I don't need metabolism marketing in an energy drink.

first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Good. Read one, then decide if the result even matters to you. I'll be loud about it either way, that's not going to change.

first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yes! Please! A headline about a study is not the study. Go find out what they measured, then come yell at me if it's smaller than it sounded.

first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then buy energy for energy. You don't have to adopt every word on the can to drink what's in it.
You already drink the standard can. Tonight there's a different one in the cooler with ESSENTIALS on it, and you have a hard session ahead.

entry-return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: You found the louder one. I was hoping you would.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I thought that was just packaging.

entry-return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Standard is 200 milligrams of caffeine. ESSENTIALS is 270.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: Seventy more isn't a cosmetic difference.

entry-return-5.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Correct. Please don't treat caffeine like a colorway. I want you fired up, not just louder.

choice-return.speaker: CELSIUS
text: So which one's coming with you tonight?

choices.text: I like being able to choose based on the day.
That's a lot of caffeine for one can.
I don't want my routine escalating to stronger energy drinks.

return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Good. Hard day, hard can. Easy day, regular can. Some days, no can. I can say that. I can say it once.

return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yes. It is. If 270 isn't right for you, don't turn it into a dare. I'm the last one who should say that, so listen when I do.

return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then stay with 200 or skip me.

return-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: No challenge?

return-3-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Caffeine isn't a toughness contest, even for me.
